description: A PaymentLink contains the details necessary to create a Transaction via HPP

merchant.title: ResourceURL<Merchant>
merchant.description: Merchant [Resource URL](#section/Overview/Values). Suppressed when a public API key is used

url.description: The external URL which is shared with the card holder

returnUrl.description: URL to redirect to after payment details are collected.

createdBy.description: Who or what created the payment link?

cancelledBy.description: Who or what cancelled the payment link?

doCancel.description: Cancel payment link. Defaults to false.

doCapture.description: This value will be passed along to any transaction created later in the payment flow. See doCapture on transaction

conversionCount.description: The number of authorized transactions created from this PaymentLink

description.description: Descriptive text indicating the purpose of the PaymentLink

debtorAccount.description: Account information required for MCC 6012/6050/6051 merchants

orderReference.description: Optional order reference which we'll display in the merchant dashboard.

shopperEmailAddress.description: Shopper's email address, useful for fraud detection and to provide a receipt

useStoredPaymentMethod.description:
When 'true', a shopper must be provided. The HPP will force the use of a stored payment method: 
customer will either pick an existing one (if applicable) or the payment information they 
enter will get saved to the associated shopper.

When 'false', HPP will not present any existing stored payment methods to the customer and the 
customer will not be asked if they would like to save the payment method to their profile.

When 'null' or not provided, if a shopper is associated with the payment session, the user will 
have the option to select from any stored payment methods attached to their shopper record. They 
will also be able to enter new payment information and optionally save it to their profile.

customReference.description: Optional reference provided by the merchant

customFields.description: Custom fields, an object containing arbitrary string values.  Field names and values must not exceed 64 and 1024 characters, respectively.
